info.title: Rikkaus Wealth OS API
info.description: Versioned REST contract for the Rikkaus Wealth OS backend. Errors follow RFC 9457 with a urn:rikkaus:problem: type.

servers.description: Relative to the deployment's own base URL

get.summary: Read the reporting currency and the declared USD/VND rate
get.description: Returns VND as the fixed reporting currency together with the rate the user declared, the date they declared it effective, and when the server stored that declaration. The three rate fields are null until a rate has been declared; that is the rate-needed state, not an error.

200.description: The settings of the signed-in user

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

put.description: Stores the rate and the date the user says it took effect, and stamps the server's own record of when it was stored. The effective date must not be in the future; it is judged as a Vietnamese civil date, not a UTC one.

400.description: The rate is missing or not positive, or the effective date is missing or in the future

errors.message: must not be in the future

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

415.description: The request body is not JSON

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

put.description: Stores the name the user chose. It is kept apart from the name Google reports, so a later sign-in refreshes the Google value without reverting this one. The email is not editable: it comes from the verified identity token.

400.description: The display name is blank or longer than 120 characters

errors.message: must not be blank

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

415.description: The request body is not JSON

get.description: Returns the liability when the signed-in user owns it. An identifier belonging to another user answers not-found with the same body a missing identifier produces.

400.description: The identifier in the path is not a UUID

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such liability, or it belongs to another user

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

put.description: Replaces every field except the category, which is chosen once when the liability is created. An omitted optional field is cleared, because this is a replacement rather than a patch: omitting collateralAssetId unlinks the collateral. The same rules as creation apply, and the collateral is re-checked against the signed-in user.

200.description: The liability as it now stands

400.description: A required field is missing, an amount is negative or too precise, a recurring payment is not positive or is half-stated, a date is inconsistent, or the collateral is not an asset the signed-in user owns

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such liability, it belongs to another user, or a concurrent request removed it first

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

415.description: The request body is not JSON

delete.description: Deletes the liability when the signed-in user owns it. Cash-flow entries linked to it are kept with linkedLiabilityId cleared, and while there is at least one the delete is refused with 409 linked-records, carrying the same impact GET .../deletion-impact returns, unless the request says confirm=true. A liability nothing refers to deletes without it. Nothing is recoverable afterwards. A second delete of the same identifier answers not-found, the same answer any unknown identifier gets. Two deletes that overlap give one 204 and not-found to the rest rather than a server error. The pledged asset, if any, is untouched.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: true once the user has seen and accepted the linked-record effects. Absent or false: a liability with linked entries is not deleted.

400.description: The identifier in the path is not a UUID, or confirm is not a boolean

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such liability, it belongs to another user, or a concurrent request removed it first

409.description: linked-records: cash-flow entries would be unlinked and confirm=true was not sent. Nothing was deleted; the impact member says what the confirmed delete would do

put.description: Replaces every field of the entry with the body, which is the same shape as the create body. An omitted optional member — recurrence, endDate, linkedAssetId, linkedLiabilityId, notes — is cleared, because this is a replacement rather than a patch. Nothing is frozen after creation: the type, category and amount may all change.

200.description: The entry as it now stands

400.description: The same refusals as on create, or the identifier in the path is not a UUID

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such entry, it belongs to another user, or a concurrent request removed it first

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

415.description: The request body is not JSON

delete.description: Deletes the entry when the signed-in user owns it. Nothing refers to an entry, so there is never a linked-record confirmation; GET .../deletion-impact names the computed views that stop including it. Nothing is recoverable afterwards. A second delete of the same identifier answers not-found, the same answer any unknown identifier gets. Two deletes that overlap, which is what a double-tapped confirm button produces, give one 204 and not-found to the rest rather than a server error.

400.description: The identifier in the path is not a UUID

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such entry, it belongs to another user, or a concurrent request removed it first

get.description: Returns the asset when the signed-in user owns it. An identifier belonging to another user answers not-found with the same body a missing identifier produces, so the response cannot be used to discover which identifiers exist.

400.description: The identifier in the path is not a UUID

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such asset, or it belongs to another user

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

put.description: Replaces the name, liquidity, the optional common fields and the four instrument fields. An omitted optional field is cleared, because this is a replacement rather than a patch, which is how a ticker recorded by mistake is removed. The instrument fields are judged against the asset's stored category, because the category is not editable here. The current value, its currency, the valuation date and the category are not editable here: a new value is recorded through POST /api/v1/assets/{assetId}/valuations and the asset follows it, and the category is chosen once when the asset is created.

200.description: The asset as it now stands

400.description: The name or liquidity is missing, a value is negative or too precise, a quantity is not positive, the purchase date is in the future or later than the asset's stored valuation date, or an instrument field was sent for an asset whose stored category does not accept it

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such asset, it belongs to another user, or a concurrent request removed it first

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

415.description: The request body is not JSON

delete.description: Deletes the asset and its valuation history when the signed-in user owns it. When a liability uses the asset as collateral or a cash-flow entry is linked to it, those records are kept with the reference cleared, and the delete is refused with 409 linked-records, carrying the same impact GET .../deletion-impact returns, unless the request says confirm=true. An asset nothing refers to deletes without it. Nothing is recoverable afterwards. A second delete of the same identifier answers not-found, the same answer any unknown identifier gets. Two deletes that overlap, which is what a double-tapped confirm button produces, give one 204 and not-found to the rest rather than a server error.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: true once the user has seen and accepted the linked-record effects. Absent or false: an asset with linked records is not deleted.

400.description: The identifier in the path is not a UUID, or confirm is not a boolean

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such asset, it belongs to another user, or a concurrent request removed it first

409.description: linked-records: other records would be unlinked and confirm=true was not sent. Nothing was deleted; the impact member says what the confirmed delete would do

get.description: Returns every liability the viewer owns, soonest next payment first, those with no next payment date after them, and then by name. An empty catalog is an empty array and a 200, not a 404. Amounts are reported in each liability's own currency; converting a USD balance to VND is the client's, using the rate from GET /api/v1/settings/exchange-rate. The optional q, category, currency and sort parameters narrow and reorder the catalog; without them the response is the whole catalog in the default order.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches the name and notes. Substring match that ignores letter case and Vietnamese diacritics, so "thao dien" finds "Căn hộ Thảo Điền". Surrounding spaces are ignored and an empty value means no search. % and _ are literal characters, not wildcards. At most 120 characters; a longer value or one containing U+0000 is rejected as validation-failed naming q.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Keeps the liabilities in these categories. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Keeps the liabilities in these currencies. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: nextPaymentDate (the default) lists the soonest payment first; -nextPaymentDate the latest first; name and -name by name. A liability with no next payment date is last in both date orders. One key; a leading - sorts descending. Ties are broken by the default order and then by id, so the order is stable between requests. Any other key, or more than one, is rejected as validation-failed naming sort.

an empty catalog, or nothing matches the.description: an empty catalog, or nothing matches the search

a mortgage with collateral and a card ba.description: a mortgage with collateral and a card balance

value.name: Vay mua nhà Vietcombank
value.notes: Thế chấp căn hộ Thảo Điền.

400.description: A search longer than 120 characters or containing U+0000, an unknown category or currency, or an unknown sort key. Every rejected parameter is named in errors, and the value sent is never repeated.

post.description: Creates a liability owned by the signed-in user. Terms and schedule are recorded as stated and nothing is computed from them. The maturity date must not be before the start date, the next payment date must fall inside the term when the term is given, the recurring amount and frequency come as a pair, and a collateral must be an asset the signed-in user owns.

400.description: A required field is missing, an amount is negative or too precise, a recurring payment is not positive or is half-stated, a date is inconsistent, or the collateral is not an asset the signed-in user owns. An unrecognised category, currency or frequency is a malformed-request instead, because the body cannot be parsed.

get.description: Returns every goal the viewer owns, nearest target date first and then by name. An empty list is an empty array and a 200, not a 404. Every amount is in VND. No projection is included: completion, remaining amount, remaining time, required contribution and status arrive with issue #89. The optional q, type and sort parameters narrow and reorder the list; without them the response is every goal in the default order.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches the name. Substring match that ignores letter case and Vietnamese diacritics, so "thao dien" finds "Căn hộ Thảo Điền". Surrounding spaces are ignored and an empty value means no search. % and _ are literal characters, not wildcards. At most 120 characters; a longer value or one containing U+0000 is rejected as validation-failed naming q.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Keeps the goals created from these templates. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: targetDate (the default) lists the nearest target date first and then by name; -targetDate the furthest first; name and -name by name. One key; a leading - sorts descending. Ties are broken by the default order and then by id, so the order is stable between requests. Any other key, or more than one, is rejected as validation-failed naming sort.

get.summary: List the signed-in user's cash-flow entries
get.description: Returns every income and expense entry the viewer owns, newest effective date first and then newest created first. An empty catalog is an empty array and a 200, not a 404. Amounts are reported in each entry's own currency; converting a USD entry to VND is the client's, using the rate from GET /api/v1/settings/exchange-rate. A recurring entry is one row, not one row per month: the dates it falls on are GET /api/v1/cash-flow-occurrences. The optional q, entryType, category, timing, recurrence, currency, effectiveFrom, effectiveTo and sort parameters narrow and reorder the catalog; without them the response is the whole catalog in the default order.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches the notes, the entry's one free-text field. Substring match that ignores letter case and Vietnamese diacritics, so "thao dien" finds "Căn hộ Thảo Điền". Surrounding spaces are ignored and an empty value means no search. % and _ are literal characters, not wildcards. At most 120 characters; a longer value or one containing U+0000 is rejected as validation-failed naming q.

parameters.name: entryType
parameters.description: Keeps the entries of these types. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Keeps the entries in these categories. A category that does not belong to a type kept by entryType simply matches nothing. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: timing
parameters.description: Keeps one-time or recurring entries. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: recurrence
parameters.description: Keeps the recurring entries with these recurrences; a one-time entry has none and is never kept by this filter. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Keeps the entries in these currencies. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: effectiveFrom
parameters.description: Keeps the entries whose stored effective date is on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD. It filters the start date of a recurring entry, not the dates it falls on; those are GET /api/v1/cash-flow-occurrences.

parameters.name: effectiveTo
parameters.description: Keeps the entries whose stored effective date is on or before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be before effectiveFrom.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: -effectiveDate (the default) lists the newest effective date first and then the newest created; effectiveDate the oldest first. One key; a leading - sorts descending. Ties are broken by the default order and then by id, so the order is stable between requests. Any other key, or more than one, is rejected as validation-failed naming sort.

post.description: Creates an income or expense entry owned by the signed-in user. The category must belong to the entry type. A one-time entry has an effective date and nothing else; a recurring one has a start date, a recurrence and an optional end date. Dates may be in the future: an expected entry is a legitimate one. An entry may link to one of the viewer's assets or one of their liabilities, never both; a linked record that is not the viewer's, or that does not exist, is refused with the same message either way.

400.description: A required field is missing, the amount is not positive or too precise, the category does not belong to the entry type, the recurrence or end date does not fit the timing, the end date precedes the effective date, a linked asset or liability is not the viewer's, or both links are sent together. Every problem is reported at once in the errors array. An unrecognised constant is a malformed-request instead, because the body cannot be parsed.

post.summary: Add an asset to the catalog
post.description: Creates an asset owned by the signed-in user, and the first record of its valuation history with the same value, currency, date and optional rate snapshot. All prices are manually entered; there is no market-price integration in MVP 1A. The valuation date must not be in the future and a purchase date must not be later than it, both judged as Vietnamese civil dates. A later value is recorded through POST /api/v1/assets/{assetId}/valuations, never by editing this one. The four instrument fields are optional everywhere they are accepted, and sending none of them is valid for every category. A symbol, a cost per unit or a current price per unit is accepted only for LISTED_SECURITIES, BOND, INVESTMENT_FUND and OTHER_ASSET; an interest rate only for BOND, TERM_DEPOSIT and OTHER_ASSET. currentValue is never derived from a quantity and a unit price, and a request where their product differs from it is stored as sent.

An unrecognised category, currency or liquidity is a malformed-request instead, because the body cannot be parsed.

get.description: Returns every valuation ever recorded for the asset, newest first: latest effective date, and between two records on one date the later recorded. Exactly one record is marked current, and it is the one the asset's currentValue, currency and valuationDate are taken from. Values are in the asset's own currency with the rate the user applied; converting to VND is the client's. An asset always has at least one record, written when it was created.

get.summary: Report the signed-in user's cash flow for one calendar month
get.description: Expands the viewer's entries into the month exactly as GET /api/v1/cash-flow-occurrences does for the window from the first to the last day of the month, and sums those occurrences. Every amount is in VND. A USD entry is converted with the rate the user has declared, one occurrence at a time, rounded half-up to whole dong; the rate and its effective date are returned in exchangeRate. Without a declared rate a USD occurrence keeps its originalAmount, its amount is null, it is left out of every total, complete is false and unconverted says how much was left out. net is income minus expense. Each composition lists the categories present, largest first, with shares apportioned by largest remainder so they sum to exactly 100.0. Passive income is income linked to an asset, grouped by asset; income in a passive-kind category with no link is reported as unassigned and not counted as passive. Every total equals the sum of the occurrences returned. A month with no occurrence is the same structure with zeros and empty arrays, and a share that cannot be computed is null. Past, current and future months are answered alike; nothing is compared with today and nothing is stored.

get.summary: List the occurrences of the signed-in user's cash-flow entries in a window
get.description: Expands every one-time and recurring entry the viewer owns into the dates it falls on from `from` to `to`, both included. A recurring entry's first occurrence is its effective date and its last is on or before its end date, both included. A day of month the month does not have moves back to that month's last day and is marked shiftedToMonthEnd; the next month returns to the entry's own day. Each occurrence belongs to the month containing its date, so two windows that meet without sharing a day count every occurrence exactly once. Dates are calendar dates with no time or zone, so the answer does not depend on when or where it is asked. Occurrences are computed on every read and never stored; editing or deleting an entry changes its occurrences immediately. Ordered by date, then by sourceEntryId. An empty window is an empty array.

get.summary: Project the signed-in user's cash over three whole months
get.description: Three calendar months starting at `from`, or at the month after today in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh when it is absent. Only records the user can see contribute: the occurrences of their one-time and recurring cash-flow entries, expanded with the rules of /cash-flow-occurrences; the payments of their liabilities, counted from nextPaymentDate every recurringPaymentFrequency and never after maturityDate; and their CASH and BANK_ACCOUNT assets as the opening balance, applied at the start of the first day. A liability with a recurring entry linked to it that overlaps the horizon is counted through that entry only. USD amounts are converted with the user's declared rate and each amount is rounded to whole đồng before it is added, so a month's items add up to its totals exactly. The lowest position is judged on the opening balance and at the end of every day an amount lands. Every record that could have contributed and does not is listed in excludedSources with its reason; without a declared rate, USD records are excluded and the months they fall in are partial rather than the request failing. The days between today and the horizon are not projected and are named in assumptions.notProjected. Computed on every read and never stored. The same records, day and `from` give the same bytes.

rateEffectiveDate.description: The date the user states that rate took effect. Must not be in the future. Only together with usdToVndRate.

note.description: Why this record exists. Required when correcting an earlier record; otherwise optional.
note.example: Cập nhật số dư sau khi đối chiếu sao kê.

correctsValuationId.description: The earlier record of this asset that this one corrects. The original is kept unchanged and stays readable; this record carries the reason in note.

AssetValuationResponse.description: One record in an asset's valuation history.

assetId.description: The asset this record belongs to.

value.description: What the asset was worth, in its own currency.

effectiveDate.description: The date the user states the value was true.

usdToVndRate.description: The USD/VND rate the user applied when recording this value. Null on a VND record, and null when the user did not capture it.

rateEffectiveDate.description: The date the user states that rate took effect. Null whenever usdToVndRate is.

note.description: The user's note, or the reason for a correction. Null when not given.
note.example: Cập nhật số dư sau khi đối chiếu sao kê.

correctsValuationId.description: The record this one corrects, when it is a correction. Null otherwise.

current.description: True on exactly one record of an asset: the one its current value, currency and valuation date are taken from. Latest effective date wins; between two on the same date, the later recorded.

recordedAt.description: When the server stored this record.

UpdateOnboardingRequest.description: Record progress through the guided onboarding. Send only what changed.

currentStep.description: The step the user is now viewing, 1 to 7 in the backbone order. The client resumes here next time.

dashboardReviewed.description: Whether the user has reviewed their first dashboard. true records the first review and keeps its moment if sent again; false withdraws it.

status.description: COMPLETED or DISMISSED ends the guided flow; IN_PROGRESS reopens it. Completion does not require every step to be done.

OnboardingResponse.description: The signed-in user's guided-onboarding checklist and where they are in it.

status.description: Where the user stands in the flow as a whole.

currentStep.description: The step the user last viewed, 1 to 7. 1 until the client records one.

steps.description: All seven steps, always in backbone order.

dashboardReviewedAt.description: When the user first reviewed their dashboard. Null until the client records it.

completedAt.description: When the user completed the flow. Null unless status is COMPLETED.

dismissedAt.description: When the user dismissed the flow. Null unless status is DISMISSED.

OnboardingStepState.description: One checklist step and whether it is done now.

key.description: Which step this is. The client maps it to its copy.

done.description: Whether the user's records satisfy this step right now. Deleting the last such record makes it false again.

DeletionImpact.description: What deleting this record does to other stored records and to computed views, read from the database at the moment of the request.

recordType.description: The kind of record being deleted.

confirmationRequired.description: True when at least one linkedEffects entry is UNLINKED. A DELETE of this record then answers 409 linked-records unless it carries confirm=true.

linkedEffects.description: Stored records the delete removes or changes. Only kinds with at least one affected record appear.

derivedEffects.description: Computed views that will no longer include this record. Descriptive: nothing is stored for them and nothing is counted.

LinkedRecordEffect.description: One kind of stored record the delete reaches, and what happens to it.

effect.description: DELETED: removed together with the record. UNLINKED: kept, with the field named in field set to null.

field.description: For UNLINKED, the response member that becomes null on each affected record. Null for DELETED.

count.description: How many records are affected. Always at least 1.

records.description: The affected records, for UNLINKED. Empty for DELETED, where only the count is given.

LinkedRecordReference.description: An affected record, identified for display.

label.description: The user's label for it: a liability's name, a cash-flow entry's notes. Null for an entry recorded without notes.

GoalTemplateResponse.description: A goal template: a type and the suggested defaults for a new goal of that type.

type.description: The type a goal created from this template carries.

defaultExpectedAnnualReturnPercent.description: The suggested expected annual return, in percent. A suggestion, not a promise.

defaultHorizonMonths.description: How many months from today to suggest as the target date.

amountPrefill.description: Which amount the form should suggest, and from what figure the client already holds.

MonthlyCashFlowReport.description: Income, expense, net, composition and passive income of one calendar month, in VND.

from.description: The first day of the month, included.

to.description: The last day of the month, included.

currency.description: The currency every amount except originalAmount and unconverted is in.

exchangeRate.description: The USD/VND rate the user has declared, applied to every USD line. Null when none is declared, in which case no USD line is converted.

complete.description: False when a USD line could not be converted for lack of a rate. The totals then cover only the converted lines and unconverted says what was left out.

incomeComposition.description: Income by category, largest amount first, then by category name.

expenseComposition.description: Expense by category, largest amount first, then by category name.

occurrences.description: Every occurrence in the month, ordered by date and then by sourceEntryId, as GET /api/v1/cash-flow-occurrences orders them.

MonthlyCashFlowReportAssetIncome.description: One asset's linked income in the month.

assetId.description: The asset; GET /api/v1/assets/{assetId} reads its name.

amount.description: Sum of the lines linked to this asset.

sharePercentOfIncome.description: amount as a percent of total income, one decimal, rounded on its own.

MonthlyCashFlowReportCategoryShare.description: One category's part of its type's total.

amount.description: Sum of the category's converted lines.

sharePercent.description: Percent of the type's total at one decimal. The rows of one composition are apportioned by largest remainder so they sum to exactly 100.0. Null when the type's total is zero.

occurrenceCount.description: How many lines of the month are in this category.

partial.description: True when a line of this category is unconverted and left out of amount.

MonthlyCashFlowReportLine.description: One occurrence in the month, traceable to its entry by sourceEntryId and occurrenceDate.

sequence.description: Position in the entry's series, 1 for a one-time entry.

linkedAssetId.description: The asset the entry is linked to. Null when it has none.

notes.description: The entry's note. Null when it has none.

originalAmount.description: The entry's amount in its own currency.

amount.description: The amount in VND: the original for a VND entry, originalAmount times exchangeRate.usdToVndRate rounded half-up to whole dong for a USD one. Null for a USD entry when no rate is declared.

MonthlyCashFlowReportPassiveIncome.description: Income linked to an asset, grouped by that asset. Passive income is decided by the link the user entered, never inferred from a category.

sharePercentOfIncome.description: total as a percent of total income, one decimal. Null when there is no income.

byAsset.description: One row per linked asset, largest amount first, then by assetId.

MonthlyCashFlowReportRate.description: The declared rate the report applied.

usdToVndRate.description: How many VND one USD buys.

effectiveDate.description: The date the user declared the rate took effect.

MonthlyCashFlowReportTotals.description: The month's totals over converted lines.

income.description: Sum of the INCOME lines' amount.

expense.description: Sum of the EXPENSE lines' amount.

net.description: income minus expense, and nothing else. Negative when spending exceeds income.

MonthlyCashFlowReportUnassigned.description: Income in RENTAL_INCOME, DIVIDEND, DEPOSIT_INTEREST or BOND_OR_FUND_INCOME with no asset link. Shown so it can be linked; not counted in passive income.

MonthlyCashFlowReportUnconverted.description: The USD lines left out of every total because no rate is declared.

occurrenceCount.description: How many lines have a null amount.

income.description: Sum of the unconverted INCOME lines' originalAmount, in USD.

expense.description: Sum of the unconverted EXPENSE lines' originalAmount, in USD.

CashFlowOccurrenceResponse.description: A date on which one of the signed-in user's cash-flow entries applies.

sourceEntryId.description: The entry this occurrence comes from; GET /api/v1/cash-flow-entries/{id} reads it.

occurrenceDate.description: The calendar date the occurrence falls on.

sequence.description: The occurrence's position in its entry's series, counted from the effective date. Always 1 for a one-time entry.

shiftedToMonthEnd.description: True when the entry's day of month does not exist in this month, so the occurrence was moved back to the month's last day.

entryType.description: INCOME or EXPENSE, as on the entry.

amount.description: The entry's amount, in its own currency. Always positive.

currency.description: The currency the amount is expressed in.

recurrence.description: MONTHLY, QUARTERLY or YEARLY for a recurring entry. Null for a one-time one.

CashFlowForecastHorizon.description: The three whole calendar months the forecast covers.

CashFlowForecastItem.description: One projected amount and the record it comes from.

direction.description: INCOME raises the projected cash, EXPENSE lowers it.

sourceId.description: The record; GET /api/v1/cash-flow-entries/{id} or /api/v1/liabilities/{id} reads it.

amount.description: The amount in the record's own currency.

amountVnd.description: The amount in VND, rounded to whole đồng.

cadence.description: MONTHLY, QUARTERLY or YEARLY for an entry; MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, SEMIANNUAL or YEARLY for a liability; null for a one-time entry.

sequence.description: The date's position in the record's series: counted from an entry's effective date, or from a liability's next payment date.

shiftedToMonthEnd.description: True when the record's day of month does not exist in this month.

CashFlowForecastMonth.description: One calendar month of the horizon.

income.description: The VND sum of the month's INCOME items.

expense.description: The VND sum of the month's EXPENSE items.

openingBalance.description: Projected cash at the start of the month's first day.

closingBalance.description: Projected cash at the end of the month's last day.

lowestBalance.description: The lowest of the month's opening balance and every end-of-day balance on a day an amount lands.

lowestBalanceDate.description: The earliest date the lowest balance is reached.

partial.description: True when an excluded record would have contributed to this month: a liability falling due in it without a schedule, or a USD amount without a rate.

items.description: Ordered by date, then CASH_FLOW_ENTRY before LIABILITY, then sourceId.

CashFlowForecastOpeningBalance.description: The cash the projection starts from, applied at the start of the horizon's first day.

amount.description: The sum of the counted sources, in VND.

appliedOn.description: The first day of the horizon.

sources.description: The cash and bank accounts counted, ordered by sourceId. A USD account without a declared rate is in excludedSources instead.

CashFlowForecastOpeningSource.description: A cash or bank account counted in the opening balance.

valuationDate.description: The date the user states the value was true.

amount.description: The value in the asset's own currency.

CashFlowForecastResponse.description: A three-month projection of the signed-in user's cash from the records they can see.

excludedSources.description: Records that could have contributed and do not, each with its reason. Ordered by sourceType, then sourceId.

partial.description: True when any month is partial or a cash or bank account could not be counted in the opening balance.

CashFlowForecastAssumptions.description: The inputs the projection rests on.

asOfDate.description: The day the forecast was computed, in timeZone.

timeZone.description: The zone today is read in.

currency.description: The currency every total is expressed in.

exchangeRate.description: The rate USD amounts were converted with. Null when the user has declared none.

openingBalanceCategories.description: The asset categories the opening balance is made of.

notProjected.description: The days between today and the horizon that are not projected. Null when there are none.

CashFlowForecastDateRange.description: A range of calendar days, both included.

CashFlowForecastExchangeRate.description: The user-declared USD/VND rate the forecast used.

usdToVndRate.description: How many VND one USD buys.

effectiveDate.description: The date the user declares the rate took effect.

CashFlowForecastExclusion.description: A record that could have contributed to the forecast and does not.

affectedMonths.description: The horizon months it would have contributed to, when known. Each is marked partial.

linkedEntryIds.description: For COVERED_BY_LINKED_ENTRIES, the recurring entries linked to the liability that count it instead. Empty otherwise.

CashFlowForecastMinimumBalance.description: The lowest projected cash position in the horizon and how it reads.

date.description: The earliest date the lowest position is reached.

negative.description: True when the lowest position is below zero.

referenceThreshold.description: One month of projected expense: the horizon's expense divided by three.

status.description: INSUFFICIENT_DATA when no cash or bank account was counted; else NEGATIVE below zero, THIN below the threshold, ADEQUATE otherwise.

X-Correlation-Id.description: Correlation identifier. Send one matching ^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,64}$ to have it echoed; anything else is replaced with a generated value and the request still succeeds. Always returned.

bearerAuth.description: The access token returned by /api/v1/auth/google or /api/v1/auth/refresh. Short-lived; renew with the refresh token rather than waiting for a 401.
